title: Fix production audit findings: sitemap, favicon, web security headers, page titles, Shiba button clipping, auth-guard blank flash

spec.problem: Production audit of kiokoto.com (af387e4b) identified six web issues: missing /sitemap.xml, missing /favicon.ico rewrite, absent web security headers, missing register/feedback page titles, clipped Shiba companion mascot button on mobile, and blank main flash on auth-guarded pages.

acceptance.text: AC1: apps/web/app/sitemap.ts exists, typechecks, and lists the public routes x 3 locales; robots.ts references the sitemap.
AC2: apps/web/next.config.mjs rewrites /favicon.ico -> /pwa-icon.svg and the existing /api rewrite still works.
AC3: apps/web/next.config.mjs headers() returns the five admin-mirrored security headers for /(.*) and no CSP/HSTS.
AC4: register and feedback pages set document.title from i18n metaTitle (keys present in vi/ja/en for both).
AC5: companion mascot markup/styles give the avatar an explicit square box with no clipping overflow; existing companion-bot tests still pass.
AC6: flashcards, quiz and battle pages render a loading state while auth is loading instead of blank/protected content; redirect behavior unchanged; existing related tests pass.
AC7: pnpm quality verify passes, task WEB-432 is CLOSED via the harness, and git status shows only the intended files changed.

spec.expected_behavior: sitemap.ts lists 17 public routes across vi/ja/en and robots.ts references the sitemap; next.config.mjs rewrites /favicon.ico to /pwa-icon.svg while keeping /api proxy and sets the 5 admin-mirrored security headers without CSP/HSTS; register and feedback set document.title (and metadata) from i18n metaTitle; companion mascot uses an explicit 48px square box with non-clipping overflow; RequireAuth renders a loading state while auth is loading/redirecting without exposing protected content.
spec.observed_behavior: /sitemap.xml and /favicon.ico return 404; apps/web sends no security headers; /vi/register and /vi/feedback keep generic Kiokoto title; companion mascot container lacks explicit height and BattleBotAvatar clips with overflow-hidden; RequireAuth returns null while auth is loading causing blank main flash on /flashcards, /quiz, and /battle.

classification.rationale: Web-only UI, metadata, and Next.js config bugfixes; no DB, API contract, or Go changes.
